title: Tesla invoice archive
description: Keep original charging invoices locally, review their details, and connect them to your charging history.
limits: PDF or ZIP, up to 20 MB per upload, 5 MB per PDF, 50 ZIP entries and 20 pages per PDF. Imports are atomic; a rejected file rejects the whole upload.
recent: The latest 100 invoices are shown. Monthly exports include all records for the selected month. Without an invoice date, the UTC import month is used.
deleted: Upload deleted. {restored} prior costs restored; {preserved} later changes preserved.
confirmDelete: Delete {filename} and every invoice it contains? Original files will be removed. Invoice costs will be restored only if they have not changed since enrichment.
reviewHint: Check the original PDF before saving. Suggestions do not change charging costs. A probable match needs your review; missing details remain unknown. Charging start requires a time zone, for example 2026-09-01T12:30:00+02:00.
enriched: Invoice cost applied. Delete the original upload to reverse it; later manual changes are preserved.
enrich: Apply this invoice amount to the selected session. Only empty or automatic costs can be replaced; the previous value and source are saved.

fields.chargingStart: Charging start (ISO date with time zone)
fields.chargeSessionId: Charging session ID (leave empty to keep unmatched)

errors.archive-unavailable: The archive is unavailable. Check the database and try again.
errors.invalid-upload: The upload is invalid, incomplete, encrypted or exceeds a processing limit. Use complete PDFs or a ZIP containing only PDFs.
errors.invalid-input: Check the entered values. Use an ISO timestamp with a time zone, a valid date, a 17-character VIN and a three-letter currency.
errors.parser-busy: Another import is being processed. Try again shortly.
errors.parser-timeout: Processing took too long. Try a smaller upload.
errors.parser-unavailable: The PDF processor is unavailable. Check the installation.
errors.archive-full: The archive has reached its 1 GB storage limit. Export and delete older uploads.
errors.duplicate-pdf-in-upload: This upload contains the same PDF more than once.
errors.pdf-already-archived: A PDF in this upload is already archived. Remove that duplicate from the ZIP and try again.
errors.existing-cost-protected: This session already has a manual or imported cost. Match the invoice without applying its amount.
errors.charge-already-matched: Another invoice already matches this session.
errors.vehicle-mismatch: The invoice VIN does not match the selected vehicle.
errors.invalid-charge-match: Select an existing completed DC charging session.
errors.cost-requires-match-and-amount: Applying a cost requires a charging session, total amount and currency.
errors.incomplete-body: The upload was interrupted. Try again.
